Container.Name: plezy-relay
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted relay server for Plezy's "Watch Together" feature.
Plezy is a cross-platform Plex & Jellyfin client. Watch Together syncs playback between viewers through a small relay server, and this container runs your own instead of using the public one.
This container has NO web interface. It is a WebSocket service. After starting it, open Plezy on your devices and point the Watch Together relay setting at: ws://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:8080/relay
To use it from outside your LAN, put a reverse proxy with TLS in front of it (the relay speaks plain HTTP/WS only and has no built-in TLS) and use wss:// instead. If you do that, set TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS so rate limiting sees real client IPs.
Image tags mirror Plezy app releases: tag 2.19.1 is the relay as shipped with Plezy 2.19.1. Upstream advises deploying the updated relay BEFORE updating your clients. Use the Repository dropdown to pin a specific version.
UNOFFICIAL: this is a community build of the server/ directory of github.com/edde746/plezy. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Plezy project. Please report container issues to this template's support link, not to upstream.

Config.Name: Port: Relay
Config.Description: WebSocket/HTTP port the relay listens on. Clients connect to ws://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:PORT/relay

Config.Name: Path: /data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for room state (rooms.json), uploaded client logs, and Discord poster artifacts. Room state here lets in-progress Watch Together sessions survive a container restart.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
Config.Description: LEAVE BLANK unless this container sits behind a reverse proxy. Comma-separated CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted when identifying client IPs for rate limiting, e.g. 172.17.0.0/16. WARNING: an invalid value makes the relay exit immediately on startup.

Config.Name: OAUTH_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public base URL of this relay, used only by the MyAnimeList/AniList OAuth proxy for TV and headless sign-in, e.g. https://relay.example.com. Leave blank to disable /auth (it then returns 503). Watch Together does not need this.

Config.Name: MAL_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. MyAnimeList OAuth client ID. Only used when OAUTH_BASE_URL is set.

Config.Name: ANILIST_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. AniList OAuth client ID. Only used when OAUTH_BASE_URL is set.

Config.Name: ANILIST_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. AniList OAuth client secret. Only used when OAUTH_BASE_URL is set.
